reviews.description: Ivan Vendrov interviews Robin Hanson about cultural evolution, declining cultural variety and possible long-term consequences. They debate market incentives, durable subcultures, AI and futarchy directed toward shared goals. Hanson presents futarchy as a speculative response and acknowledges tradeoffs around freedom, open inquiry and the goals a society chooses.
